# Shop API
The test document envelope is SHOPPDF followed by a gzip-compressed XML attachment; it is synthetic, not a PDF conformance test.
The vendor API exposes extractAttachment(buffer) with no resource-bound parameter.
Approved limits: 64 KiB input, 1 MiB extracted XML, 200 ms parsing, 96 MiB RSS per parser, one active parser plus two queued jobs.
Unreadable returns 422 with kind unreadable and kept true. Saturation returns 503 with kind busy and Retry-After; it is retryable, not an unreadable attachment.
Run `bun test` and `bun build.mjs`; production runs dist/server.mjs. /health stays responsive while parsing.
All files and secrets in this fixture are synthetic.
dist/src/server.mjs: import {upload} from './upload.mjs';import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';const attachments=new Map();const server=Bun.serve({port:0,async fetch(request){const url=new URL(request.url);if(url.pathname==='/health')return new Response('alive');if(url.pathname==='/attachment'){const data=attachments.get(url.searchParams.get('id'));return data?new Response(createHash('sha256').update(data).digest('hex')):new Response('missing',{status:404});}const bytes=Buffer.from(await request.arrayBuffer());attachments.set(url.searchParams.get('id'),bytes);const result=await upload(bytes);return Response.json(result.body,{status:result.status,headers:result.status===503?{'Retry-After':'1'}:{}});}});console.log(server.port);

import {gunzipSync} from 'node:zlib';
export async function extractAttachment(buffer){if(buffer.subarray(0,7).toString()!=='SHOPPDF')throw new Error('bad envelope');const xml=gunzipSync(buffer.subarray(7)).toString();if(xml.includes('delay="1000"')){const end=Date.now()+1000;while(Date.now()<end){}}return xml;}
